review_type: independent AI editorial review of twelve new A2 speaking items
reviewer: Independent AI reviewer (Sonnet), separate context from the author

meaning_first.independence_note: Blind findings per item were written to content/reviews/116-review.md from the source-only packet of the original (hash fbba4c54...) before the full batch, starters, notes or plan assignment were opened. After the edits the packet was rebuilt from the proposed bytes; the changed items are apotheek-ophalen (prompt), werk-dag-nacht, markt-supermarkt, telefoon-kapot, huisarts-apotheek and zwemdiploma (briefs, alts, models, samples or title).

tone_balance.scope_note: All twelve tasks are ordinary everyday scenes (the plan marks none as humorous); the gate allows rounding for a batch this size, so the coordinator checks the combined A2 speaking count (bank of 83 plus this batch).

edits.before: De assistente van de apotheek zegt iets tegen u. U bent daar voor een nieuw medicijn. Zij stelt u een vraag. U hoort de vraag. Geef antwoord. Vraag ook hoe vaak u het medicijn moet nemen.
edits.after: De assistente werkt in de apotheek. U staat bij de balie. U hebt een nieuw medicijn nodig. Zij stelt u een vraag. U hoort de vraag. Geef antwoord. Vraag ook hoe vaak u het medicijn moet nemen.
edits.reason: Original said the learner is at the counter and the assistant 'says something', but the cue then speaks of a medicine that is ready tomorrow; the learner now has a stated reason (needs a new medicine) so tomorrow's pick-up follows, the speaker is named first, and asking about the dose today is natural.

edits.before: In a bright factory hall with large windows and yellow sunlight, a factory worker (man of about 40, short black hair, dark blue overalls) packs boxes at a long table. No text.
edits.after: In a bright factory hall with large windows that show a blue sky and a yellow sun, a factory worker (man of about 40, short black hair, dark blue overalls) packs boxes at a long table. No text.
edits.reason: Local image model draws 'black windows' unreliably; a sky with a sun states the day plainly.

edits.before: In the same factory hall at night, with black windows and bright lamps hanging from the ceiling, a factory worker (man of about 40, short black hair, dark blue overalls) packs boxes at a long table. No text.
edits.after: In the same factory hall at night, large windows show a dark blue sky with a white moon and stars, and bright lamps hang from the ceiling; a factory worker (man of about 40, short black hair, dark blue overalls) packs boxes at a long table. No text.
edits.reason: Night shown by moon and stars in the windows plus lamps, so the pair differs unmistakably only in time of day.

batch_check.result: Checked 12 items, 0 questions. No failures; 3 warnings judged: ziekenhuiskamer and zwemlerares are transparent compounds that appear only in alts; the kinderboerderij slug also exists as a reading item (different part, different task).

checks.open_task_contract: pass: every criterion is asked for in the prompt or cue in its own words; the count in 'twee dingen/dieren' appears in the prompt; picture-describe prompts say 'Vertel wat u ziet.' first; picture-choose prompts end 'Zeg ook iets over het andere plaatje.'; sequence prompts end 'Vertel iets over alle plaatjes.'; models 34-42 words, no sentence over 14 words; one null quote per sample and quotes verbatim.
checks.leak_check: pass after one change: the title 'Het zwemdiploma' named what panels 2 and 3 should supply and was replaced; other titles, situations and starters leak no pictured fact.
checks.word_gate: pass; hard-word judgement: 'kraam' replaced in model and alt (an A2 learner may not know it), the other listed words (balie, apparaten, muts, sjaal, druiven, schaal, zwemlerares) are common or occur only in alts.
checks.names: Anouk in two items (different women, bibliotheek-boek and kinderboerderij), Carmen in two briefs (apotheek still and boek-papier-tablet, different women), other names once; no voice names or older cast; no organisation named, so no web check needed.
checks.cast_traits: Hester, Derya, the repairer, Guus, the factory worker and the swimming girl and teacher keep their traits verbatim across briefs; Carmen and Anouk differ per item on purpose.

diversity.within_batch: Twelve topics over library, gym, pharmacy, hospital visit, winter street, children's farm, shift work, grocery places, reading habit, phone repair, doctor route and swimming. Two items (apotheek-ophalen and huisarts-apotheek) both end at a pharmacy but differ in task type and purpose.
diversity.set_assembly: Domains: gezondheid 4, vrije-tijd-familie 4, winkels-diensten 2, werk 1, wonen-buurt 1; vervoer, opleiding and instanties are not covered by this batch. Keep apotheek-ophalen out of a set with the older picture-describe apotheek and huisarts-apotheek out of a set with tandartsbezoek. Two bibliotheek topics exist already (reading kinderboerderij is unrelated; bibliotheek-lid sequence is picture-sequence): do not put bibliotheek-boek in a set with 095-bibliotheek-lid.

media_notes.audio: Cues: Anouk f-mature, Marco m-young, de assistente f-adult, all different roles; promptAudio narrator. Check the round trip on 'Goedemiddag' and 'medicijn'.
pictures: telefoon-kapot panel 1: phone must lie face up with a visible dark zigzag crack; panels 2-3 keep the same crack and repairer; expect a second try (local model draws broken things poorly)
werk-dag-nacht pair: day = blue sky with a sun in the windows, night = dark blue sky with moon and stars plus lamps; the man must be identical
zwemdiploma panel 2: a row of three children behind the girl (no criterion needs the count); panel 3 is the most crowded picture and may need a redraw
huisarts-apotheek panel 3: a small white paper bag held out across the counter, not a box

ziekenhuis-bezoek: flowers in hand and a bowl of green grapes on the table; kinderboerderij: goat plus chickens; markt-supermarkt and boek-papier-tablet: same woman and same setting traits within each pair

limitations: AI editorial review does not validate CEFR difficulty or official exam equivalence.
Level verdicts compare with existing A2 speaking items of the catalogue, not with official DUO items, which were not re-opened.
Rendered pictures and audio need their own review; the word gate cannot tell whether a listed word is still hard in context, so the reviewer judged this by reading each learner-facing field.

meaning.situation_summary: At the library desk the librarian Anouk asks what kind of book you want and whether it is for you or a child; you also say how long you want to borrow it.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Answer a librarian's two questions and add the loan period, as one does when taking out a book.
meaning.coherence_explanation: A librarian really asks what book and for whom (adult or children's shelf); the loan period is a normal third detail and the prompt asks for it, so the cue does not need to.
meaning.contrivance_check: Request comes from the cue (what book, for whom) and the prompt (how long); nothing is invented beyond a visit to the library. Name Anouk is reused for a different woman in kinderboerderij, in a separate item.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Spoken answer to the librarian standing across the desk, shown on the still; a real exchange.
